title: Monthly recorded detection rates
caption: Exact counts divided by dates in the requested window; January endpoints are partial. These are exported detections per calendar day, not incidents or coverage-corrected occurrence rates.

title: Global detection geography
caption: All 4,876,343 detections aggregated exactly. Degree bins have unequal physical areas; color measures recorded counts, not fire risk or burned area. Natural Earth outlines provide coarse context only.

title: Native confidence classes
caption: Low <30; nominal 30–79; high ≥80. Native confidence is not a calibrated probability of wildfire. All classes remain in the raw and EDA dataset.

title: FRP distribution
caption: Exact histogram over positive FRP; 2,425 zero-FRP rows are flagged separately and retained. FRP is instantaneous radiative power per detected pixel, not burned hectares or total energy.

title: Observed hotspot timing
caption: UTC + longitude/15 modulo 24, without equation-of-time correction. Distribution is conditional on exported hotspots; it is not a full orbit coverage schedule.

title: Hemisphere contributions
caption: Both platforms combined, split at latitude 0°. These broad descriptive groups do not isolate climate, land use, observation coverage or causal drivers.

title: Pilot monthly point calendar
caption: Blueprint rectangle: west −6.4°, south 34.5°, east −4.5°, north 35.9°. A zero means no exported retained point, not an eligible negative observation. Only 49 candidate detections remain after type/confidence filtering.

title: Pilot point locations
caption: 57 detections in the entire requested period. The rectangle is a study window; it includes no reviewed land mask or administrative clip. Symbols are pixel centers, not fire boundaries.

title: January footprint distributions
caption: FIRMS overlap January 1–17, 2025 only, 202,406 rows. Full-year MCD14ML instead provides sample index 0–1353; explicit scan/track are absent. Pixel footprint is not burning/burned area.

title: Confidence threshold sensitivity
caption: Thresholds are analysis choices. A stricter filter removes many exported detections and does not turn the retained sample into verified wildfire ground truth.

title: Thermal signal scatter
caption: Uniform reproducible 40,000-row sample for visualization, seed 20241017. Correlation tables use the full type-0 population, split by native day/night; relationships are not causal evidence or flame temperatures.
